run: writeauth-20261116T205659Z; coverage/lab/server2025/write-authentication/write-authentication-result.json records 15 mutating operations passing both halves, each leaving its native allocation counters at zero. coverage/lab/server2025/write-authentication/collector-run.json records the fixture's creation and its proved removal. The design is one ordinary identity and two containers. The identity is delegated full control on one and has no rights on the other, so the endpoint, the session, the explicit Negotiate credentials and the request are identical across both halves and the only difference is the access check. The identity's account name carries non-ASCII text and its password carries non-ASCII and supplementary Unicode. No secret reaches a command line, an environment variable or a file: the credential arrives on the test process's standard input and is cleared after use. Success: every operation succeeded under those explicit credentials inside the delegated container, which establishes that the SDK carries an explicit identity into a write and not only into a read. Failure: the same operation, same session, same credentials, against a subject in the container the identity has no rights on was refused and wrote nothing — proved by the target's uSNChanged being unchanged with the object still present, and for a create by the delegated create of the same relative name succeeding. The subjects in the denied container were placed there by the collector's own identity, so the delegated identity can read them and must not be able to change them. Fourteen refusals arrived as access denied, LDAP status 50. One did not: New-ADComputer in the denied container is refused with a constraint violation, LDAP status 19, which is Active Directory's own behaviour for an under-privileged computer creation rather than anything this SDK chooses. The qualification accepts any classification the directory produced, because the design makes the permission the only variable, but requires the refusal to carry an LDAP status: a refusal with none would have been produced by this SDK before reaching the access check, which would mean the check was never exercised. The consequence is worth stating: a caller cannot rely on a denied classification alone to detect a permission problem on computer creation. No variant state advances.
